definition: It can be both Small Language Model or Statistical Language Model
details: It can be both Small Language Model or Statistical Language Model

explainer.lead: SLM is an overloaded abbreviation: it stands for either Small Language Model or Statistical Language Model, depending on context. Disambiguating it matters because the two refer to entirely different classes of system.

tiers.eli5: It's a short label that means one of two things, like a nickname two different people share, so you check who is being talked about.
tiers.practitioner: Before acting on any document or ticket that says "SLM," engineers confirm which expansion is meant, since a small neural model and a statistical model imply different tooling and expectations. The pitfall is silently assuming the wrong one.
tiers.paperLevel: No single formal definition exists; the term resolves to either a compact neural language model or a classical statistical language model, so its limits depend on which sense is used.

explainer.example: A procurement note saying "we will deploy an SLM on-device" points to Small Language Model, while a paper on n-gram smoothing using "SLM" points to Statistical Language Model.
